title: variant.spent@1
description: A recorded call reached a held-out variant (#3229): a session working on the task, or one it started, named a digest the variant is kept by, or a path in a checkout while the variant lay there. Only the core appends it, for the task whatever the session's ID, and nothing takes it back: the variant's runs count neither way for the task's claims from then on.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

task_ref.description: The task the variant is spent for.

check.description: The check the variant is held out of.

variant.description: Its number among the check's variants, counted from 1.

digests.description: What the store keeps its files by, in order: by these it stays spent under any definition.

call.description: The agent's ID for the call, as its tool.before has it, or the hook's own ID where the agent gives none.

named.description: What the call named: a digest, or a path in a checkout while the variant lay there.

x-closure.closed: each value is a way a recorded call can reach a variant, and every reader names the call either way, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema
